title: Revoked access tokens stay valid while Redis is unavailable
expected: Logout and 'log out everywhere' take effect immediately for all tokens.
actual: Refresh-token revocation is stored in Postgres (durable). The per-request access-token revocation check reads Redis only and fails open when Redis is missing or erroring ('never block a request because Redis is down').
impact: During a Redis outage (or Upstash quota exhaustion, TD-023) a revoked or stolen access token works for up to its 15-minute lifetime.
fix: On Redis failure, fall back to authSecurityStore.isTokenRevoked (Postgres) with a short in-process cache, or reject privileged (admin, payment) requests when revocation cannot be checked.
